sn35.120:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā sāriputto sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn35.120:1.2: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn35.120:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.120:1.4: saddhivihāriko āvuso sāriputta bhikkhu sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattoti.
sn35.120:2.1: evaṃhetaṃ āvuso hoti indriyesu aguttadvārassa bhojane amattaññuno jāgariyaṃ ananuyuttassa.
sn35.120:2.2: so vatāvuso bhikkhu indriyesu aguttadvāro bhojane amattaññū jāgariyaṃ ananuyutto yāvajīvaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ santānessatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn35.120:2.3: so vatāvuso bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro bhojane mattaññū jāgariyaṃ anuyutto yāvajīvaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ santānessatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
sn35.120:3.2: idhāvuso, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
sn35.120:3.3: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
sn35.120:3.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
sn35.120:3.9: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
sn35.120:3.10: evaṃ kho āvuso indriyesu guttadvāro hoti.
sn35.120:4.3: neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya. iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi yātrā ca me bhavissati, anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti.
sn35.120:4.4: evaṃ kho āvuso bhojane mattaññū hoti.
sn35.120:5.2: idhāvuso bhikkhu divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti.
sn35.120:5.3: rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti.
sn35.120:5.4: rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeti pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā.
sn35.120:5.5: rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paccuṭṭhāya caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti.
sn35.120:5.6: evaṃ kho āvuso jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti.
sn35.120:5.8: indriyesu guttadvārā bhavissāma bhojane mattaññuno jāgariyaṃ anuyuttāti.
